title: A rework brief for a conflict or failed trial names the next action
description: A conflict trial failure tells the worker to run sync, resolve and complete; a failing test or e2e trial tells it to reproduce with run-tests.ts and complete; the base-conflict and sync-conflict reasons end with the same sync imperative; every reason fits the rework bound.

steps.name: rework reasons name sync, run-tests.ts and complete
